name: What is the difference between a new construction and an interior build-out?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a new construction and an interior build-out?

acceptedAnswer.text: New construction involves building a structure from the ground up on previously undeveloped land or after demolition. An interior build-out, in contrast, focuses on transforming the interior of an existing commercial shell or previously occupied space. While new construction establishes the primary building, an interior build-out customizes the internal environment to make it suitable for a tenant's specific operations. Both require careful planning and execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction builds a structure from scratch, while an interior build-out customizes the inside of an existing commercial space.
